_about: One entry per ad id: Claude's reading of the ad for Mum. verdict: good | maybe | longshot | no. cat/stairs/shops states: cat ok|ask|no, stairs none|lift|ask|stairs, shops close (walkable) | far (not walkable). Written by hand or by the routine; build_docs.py merges it with the search results.

rent-4394513.summary: Ground-floor 1-bedroom flat with a carport, close to shops, transport and the waterfront.

cat.note: The ad doesn't say. The agency's rental guide says pets may be considered on application. Ask.

shops.note: Walkable. The ad says it's close to shops and transport.

shops.note: Walkable. The ad says it's close to shops.

shops.note: Not walkable: most errands need a car or bus. The ad says it's close to supermarkets and Westfield North Lakes.
